title: Oven-baked sausages with vegetables
description: These oven-baked meat sausages are full of flavor and secretly hide extra vegetables. Ideal for children and adults. Serve them with applesauce and ketchup.

instructions.text: Place the grated zucchini in a clean tea towel or kitchen towel and squeeze out as much moisture as possible from the grated zucchini.
Mix the minced meat with the zucchini, carrot, grated cheese, breadcrumbs, and egg. Season with pepper and salt and mix everything well together.
Divide the mixture into 8 equal portions and roll them into firm sausages. Optionally, insert an ice cream stick into each sausage.
Place the meat sausages on a baking tray lined with baking paper and bake them for 20 to 25 minutes in the oven, until they are golden brown and cooked through.
